episode.title: Venice Stands On Millions Of Wooden Piles

synopsis: The historic stone palaces of Venice rest upon millions of petrified wooden piles driven deep into lagoon mud.

title_card.title: Venice stands on millions of wood piles.
title_card.subtitle: Submerged wood piles have held it up since 1100.

caption:
Venice stands on millions of wooden piles driven into the mud, some of them over 1,000 years old.

To construct stone foundations in a marshy lagoon around 1100, medieval builders hammered millions of oak and alder trunks into dense silt. Deprived of oxygen underwater, the timber turned rock-hard, sustaining the republic until 1797.

Visuals created with AI.

Does it surprise you that wood submerged underwater doesn't rot?
